notes.title: Hotfix update to version 1.2!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We've just updated version 1.2 to fix a few issues with 1.1. 

Changelog for version 1.2: 
- fixed issues for controllers with more than 32 buttons
- made transition to OpenTK 2.0 
- other fixes

notes.title: Hotfix update to version 1.1!
notes.content:
We've just released version 1.1 to address a few bugs and issues with 1.0. 

Changelog for version 1.1:
- fixed issues with Skip dialog
- lables and buttons do not disappear anymore
- new soundtrack
- replaced waves background
- improved Russian and Ukrainian translation
- other changes and fixes

Enjoy!
